questions.question: Why is an LLM alone not considered an autonomous agent?
options: Because it is only a text prediction system without planning, memory, or tools

questions.question: What is the main purpose of wrapping an LLM in an agent framework?
options: To convert it into a hardware processor
To enable it to perform tasks autonomously using planning, memory, and tools
To stop it from generating tokens

questions.question: Which component of an agent framework acts as the 'brain'?
In an agent framework, what does the memory component mainly provide?
options: The ability to recall past actions and information
A method for generating tokens faster

questions.question: Which two elements together form the memory system described in the chapter?
options: Short-term context window and long-term vector database

questions.question: What is the role of planning in an autonomous agent?
options: To break a large goal into smaller actionable steps

questions.question: Which of the following best describes the 'Tools/Actions' pillar?
options: External APIs that allow the agent to interact with the real world
A method to compress neural networks

questions.question: Why can the simple ReAct loop fail in complex tasks?
options: It may get trapped in repeated cycles of failing and retrying

questions.question: What is the main idea behind Chain of Thought (CoT)?
options: The model outputs only the final answer
The model explains its reasoning step-by-step before the final answer

questions.question: Why does Chain of Thought reduce hallucinations?
options: It gives the attention mechanism more intermediate reasoning context

questions.question: What is the main idea behind Tree of Thoughts (ToT)?
In Tree of Thoughts, what happens after the agent generates multiple possible plans?
options: It uses an internal judging mechanism to score them
It sends them to the user

questions.question: What does the agent do with low-scoring branches in Tree of Thoughts?
options: Abandons them and focuses on better branches
Sends them to a GPU cluster

questions.question: What technique allows an LLM to trigger real-world tools like APIs?
In function calling, what does the LLM generate instead of normal English text?
options: A structured JSON object describing the function call

questions.question: What happens after the LLM generates a tool-call JSON output?
options: The external program executes the API and returns the results
The tokenizer converts it to images

questions.question: Why are modern AI systems often built as multi-agent systems?
options: Because a single agent cannot run on GPUs
Because multiple specialized agents can divide complex tasks
Because one agent cannot generate tokens
Because agents must always run offline

questions.question: In a sequential multi-agent system, how do agents interact?
options: They pass results from one agent to the next like an assembly line

questions.question: What is the role of the Manager Agent in a hierarchical system?
options: It trains the neural network layers
It divides a complex task into sub-tasks and assigns them to workers

questions.question: Which option best summarizes the purpose of multi-agent orchestration?
options: To force a single AI model to perform every task
To coordinate multiple specialized agents to solve complex problems
To remove planning from AI systems
